signal: BTC 20日动量，阈值 ±5%；前向 20 日

backtest.rule: BTC动量<-5%→空仓，否则满仓纳指；次日生效；单边成本 5bps

verdict: 信号真·风险取舍：方向同号 4/4 段(其中 3 段优势≥5pp；早段约3pp接近噪声、强度随期递增)；裸 overlay 让出 2.86pp 年化，换 Sharpe 0.93 vs 0.83、回撤 -29.5% vs -36.4%(浅 6.9pp)——但属单一历史路径、无置信区间，可能不重复。要风险调整收益的可参考，要最大绝对收益的死拿更好。已对照纳指自身20日动量(同口径差 9.4pp)：BTC 多给约 4.6pp 增量、不只是大盘动量代理
verdict_en: Signal is real, but it is a risk trade-off: same sign in 4/4 regime segments (3 with an edge ≥5pp; the earliest segment is ~3pp and close to noise, strength increases over time); the naive overlay gives up 2.86pp of annualised return in exchange for Sharpe 0.93 vs 0.83, drawdown -29.5% vs -36.4% (6.9pp shallower) — but this is a single historical path with no confidence interval; it may not repeat. Worth a look if you optimise risk-adjusted return; if you want maximum absolute return, just hold. Controlled for NASDAQ's own 20-day momentum (same-basis gap 9.4pp): BTC adds about 4.6pp on top — not merely a proxy for broad-market momentum
caveat: 出格区·把红线此前剥掉的方向亮出来诚实检验。非荐股、非保证、会错、过去≠未来；BTC 与纳指同属高风险资产，相关≠因果；已对照纳指自身20日动量(同口径差 9.4pp)：BTC 多给约 4.6pp 增量、不只是大盘动量代理；Sharpe/回撤改善属单一历史路径、无置信区间；FRAGILE(符号一致性0.8)→ 看体制段。每跑 append 计分。
